title: helm(private): improve values schema + init hooks for upgrade/rollback compatibility
author: Maya Singh
commits: a1b2c3d: validate: add JSON schema for private.values.yaml and strictType checks
b2c3d4e: helm: add init-hook job for pre-upgrade CRD sync and secret bootstrap
c3d4e5f: templating: introduce .Values.rollback.tolerations and default merge logic
d4e5f6a: test: add unit tests for values schema + helm template assertions
e5f6a7b: docs: update private/README with upgrade/rollback notes and migration steps
description: Motivation: customers running Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) hit upgrade/rollback edge cases where helm value shape drift or missing init steps caused node taints/toleration mismatches and CRD/secret races during upgrade. This PR tightens the values schema, makes templating resilient to missing fields, and adds an explicit init-hook job to ensure CRDs and bootstrap secrets are present before controller pods start. Changes: (1) add charts/redwood-private/values.schema.json with stricter types and enum constraints for known fields (networking, storage, rollback configuration). (2) add .Values.rollback.{enabled,tolerations,gracePeriod} and merge logic in _helpers.tpl so rollback defaults are applied without requiring users to explicitly copy values. (3) new init-jobs.yaml: a helm hook (pre-upgrade, pre-install) job that waits for CRDs and creates a customer-scoped bootstrap secret when missing; job is idempotent and respects helm hook-delete-policy. (4) add unit tests under charts/.../tests to catch schema regressions and a small helm template test harness. (5) docs update describing migration path and how to opt-out of the init job. Checklist: - [x] values schema added and validated - [x] init hook implemented and tested locally - [x] templating guards for missing values - [x] unit tests added - [x] docs updated and linked to upgrade playbook Related: ENG-2148 follow-up for rollback behavior and ENG-2197 for values drift. Notes: kept the init job lightweight (timeout 5m) and configurable via .Values.initJob.enabled to allow air-gapped installs to disable it. Backwards compatibility: schema uses "additionalProperties": true for unrecognized fields to avoid breaking existing customers.
review_comments: Ethan Park: Can you add a short-circuit so the init job skips if all CRDs exist? Right now the job waits on each resource which increases install time.
Maya Singh: Added short-circuit and configurable timeout. job exits early if all CRDs present (new commit c3d4e5f).
Lena Ortiz: Please ensure the values.schema.json allows unknown top-level keys to keep backward compatibility (we still have customers with custom fields).
Maya Singh: Done — set additionalProperties=true and added explicit unit test to ensure unknown keys don't fail validation.
Diego Ramos: CI flagged a flaky e2e helm-install; looks like the toleration merge sometimes results in duplicate entries. Can we dedupe in the helper?
Maya Singh: Implemented dedupe in _helpers.tpl and added a regression test. CI rerun passed.
release_notes: Helm: Improved private chart values schema and added init hook to ensure CRDs and bootstrap secrets are present for upgrades; added rollback toleration defaults and template guards. Backwards-compatible by default; opt-out for init job via values. See docs/helm/private-upgrade-rollback.md for migration steps.
